content: <thought>The mass spectrum shows a dominant monoisotopic peak at m/z ≈ 100 with successive peaks at +1, +2, +3 Da that decrease in intensity roughly in proportion to the natural abundance of ^13C (≈1.1 %). This pattern matches the isotopic envelope expected for a molecule containing about five carbon atoms (the +1 peak is ~5 % of the monoisotopic, consistent with 5 × 1.1 %). No other element exhibits a characteristic multi‑peak pattern of this shape in the given data, so the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution is carbon.
